summary: A Brampton practice open Monday to Saturday with weekend appointments is a strength, but no visible booking path and no named dentists appear to cost you patients.

findings.problem: The FAQ appears to say patients can book online but no booking link or tool appears, and the only prominent button appears to be CALL US.
findings.cost: Patients who prefer to book online have no way to do it.
findings.fix: A booking form or calendar on the homepage.

findings.problem: No dentists are named, no testimonials or review count appear, and the page appears to show only a Google badge with no rating.
findings.cost: New patients want to know who will treat them and what others say.
findings.fix: Named dentists, credentials and visible reviews.

findings.problem: The address appears as Main Street North in the footer and Main Street in the FAQ, and the hours wording appears to suggest Saturday is the only weekend day.
findings.cost: Mixed details confuse patients planning a visit.
findings.fix: One address and one clear hours line.

findings.problem: Thanks for subscribing appears in the page content before any submission, 'We care !' has a stray space, and a sentence appears to be missing a verb.
findings.cost: Placeholder text and typos make a clinic look unfinished.
findings.fix: Proofread copy and a form message that appears only after submission.

redesign: A booking form on the homepage.
One address and hours line, with proofread copy.
